stem: A parent component must set a child component's property in markup. Which decorator goes on the child's field?
explanation: @api makes a field public, so a parent can set it as an attribute. @track only observes changes inside objects and arrays, and @AuraEnabled is an Apex annotation.

stem: Why does the Apex runtime enforce governor limits?
explanation: Apex runs on a multitenant platform where many orgs share the same resources, so limits stop one transaction from monopolizing them. Orgs do not get dedicated servers.
options: Each org runs its own server

stem: Apex inserts a detail record of a master-detail relationship but leaves the master field empty. What happens?
explanation: A detail record depends on its master and cannot stand alone, so the master-detail field must be filled. A lookup field, by contrast, can usually be left blank.
options: It links to the running user
It links to the last master used

stem: What Apex test coverage does Salesforce require to deploy to production?
explanation: Unit tests must cover at least 75% of the Apex code and all tests must pass; each trigger also needs some coverage. The 75% is cumulative, not per class.
options: Any coverage, with all tests passing
At least 90% overall, all tests passing
At least 75% overall, all tests passing
At least 75% per class, all tests passing

stem: Why does a Fast Field Updates flow cost less than an after-save flow updating the same record?
explanation: Fast Field Updates run before the record is saved, so changes ride along with the save. An after-save flow updating the same record needs another DML and save cycle.
options: It is exempt from governor limits
It needs no extra DML or second save
It runs in its own transaction

stem: A search box must find a word in Account, Contact and Lead text fields at once. Which tool fits?
explanation: SOSL searches text across several objects in one statement and returns a list of lists. SOQL queries one object (plus related ones), so LIKE would need a query per object.

stem: Dynamic SOQL adds a search term typed by the user. What best prevents SOQL injection?
explanation: A bind variable passes the input as a value, never as query text; user mode and access checks limit what a query can read but do not stop injected clauses. If the string must be built by hand, String.escapeSingleQuotes escapes the quote marks an attacker would use.
options: A bind variable for the term

stem: A trigger must set a field on each incoming Account without a DML statement. Which context fits?
explanation: Records in Trigger.new can be changed directly only in before triggers, and the change is saved with no extra DML. In after triggers Trigger.new is read-only.

stem: A team wants short-lived, source-driven orgs built from a definition file. Which org type fits?
explanation: Scratch orgs are created from a definition file such as config/project-scratch-def.json and expire, by default after 7 days and at most 30. Sandboxes are copies of production.

stem: How does a child component tell its parent that a tile was clicked?
explanation: A child sends data up by creating a CustomEvent and calling this.dispatchEvent; the parent listens with an on-prefixed attribute such as ontileclick. querySelector reaches down to children, not up.

stem: A loop issues its 101st SOQL query in a synchronous transaction. What happens?
explanation: Exceeding a governor limit throws System.LimitException, which a try/catch block cannot handle, and the transaction rolls back. Nothing is deferred or moved to asynchronous processing.
options: Query is queued for the next transaction

stem: Enrollment__c is a junction object between Course__c and Student__c. Which query lists one student's course names?
explanation: The junction holds a master-detail field to each object, so the query starts from Enrollment__c, filters on Student__c and reads the course through the __r relationship. Course__c has no Student__c field.

stem: What does code between Test.startTest() and Test.stopTest() get?
explanation: Code between startTest and stopTest gets its own set of governor limits, so set-up queries and DML do not use up the limits of the code under test.
options: A new set of governor limits

stem: A flow must call an Apex method. Which annotation exposes it as a flow action?
explanation: @InvocableMethod marks a static method that flows and other tools run as an action. @AuraEnabled serves Lightning components, @RemoteAction serves Visualforce JavaScript and @NamespaceAccessible only widens package visibility.

stem: How many SOQL queries can one synchronous Apex transaction issue?
explanation: The synchronous limit is 100 SOQL queries; asynchronous Apex gets 200. 150 is the DML statement limit.

stem: Which Visualforce markup is open to cross-site scripting?
explanation: Standard apex components escape HTML characters by default. Setting escape to false outputs user input unfiltered, so a script in it runs in the victim's browser.
options: apex:outputText with escape set to false
apex:outputField bound to a record field
apex:outputText with escape left at default

stem: Which annotation lets an LWC wire an Apex method that only reads data?
explanation: Wired Apex methods must be cacheable, so they need @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true), and they must be static and public or global. A plain @AuraEnabled method can only be called imperatively.

stem: In which two trigger contexts is Trigger.old available? (Choose two.)
explanation: Trigger.old holds the earlier versions of records, so it exists only for update and delete events. Inserted and undeleted records have no prior version in the trigger.

stem: A user reports an error. What must be set so their next actions produce a debug log?
explanation: Logs are kept for a user when a trace flag is set for that user. Class and trigger trace flags only override log levels; they do not cause logging on their own.

stem: A parent object needs the total Amount of its child records. Which declarative feature fits when the relationship is master-detail?
explanation: A roll-up summary field on the master calculates COUNT, SUM, MIN or MAX over its detail records without code. A cross-object formula reads parent fields from the child, the other direction.

stem: An Apex upsert statement names no external ID field. Which key does it use to match records?
explanation: Upsert matches on the record Id unless a custom external ID field (or an idLookup standard field) is named. Records with no Id are inserted.

stem: A test enqueues a Queueable job. When can it assert on the job's results?
explanation: Asynchronous calls made after startTest are collected, and stopTest runs them synchronously, so asserts after stopTest see the results.
options: Only in a separate test method

stem: A component shows one record's fields from its page layout and lets the user edit them. What is the simplest choice?
explanation: lightning-record-form views and edits a record with fields from a layout and needs no code. The view and edit forms are for custom layouts, and Apex is not needed for one record.

stem: Which declaration makes a class-level constant in Apex?
explanation: A constant is declared static final and assigned once. Apex has no const, readonly or var keywords for this; final is what stops reassignment.

stem: Which call inserts the valid records in a list and skips the ones that fail?
explanation: Setting allOrNone to false allows partial success; each Database.SaveResult says which records failed. The insert statement and allOrNone true roll back the whole list on any error.

stem: Which SOQL clause makes a query enforce the running user's object, field and sharing access?
explanation: WITH USER_MODE runs the query with the user's object permissions, field-level security and sharing. WITH SHARING is a class keyword, not a SOQL clause.

stem: Which requirement still calls for Apex rather than a declarative tool?
explanation: Exposing a custom SOAP or REST web service needs an Apex class. Formula fields, record-triggered flows and validation rules cover the other three without code.
options: Field update when a record is saved
Calculated field shown on a page layout
Custom web service for an outside app

stem: Invoice__c has a lookup field Customer__c to Account. How does a query on Invoice__c read the account name?
explanation: A custom relationship is traversed with the field name ending in __r. The __c name holds only the Id, and the relationship is named after the field, not the target object.

stem: In the save order of execution, what runs right after the before triggers?
explanation: After before triggers, Salesforce runs most system validation again plus custom validation rules, then duplicate rules, then saves and runs after triggers. Before-save flows run before the before triggers.

stem: A component changes one property inside an object stored in a plain field. Why doesn't the template update?
explanation: All fields are reactive when reassigned, but the framework only observes changes inside an object or array when the field has @track. @api makes a field public.
options: Template needs lwc:if to re-render it

stem: Several test methods need the same Accounts. Where should they be created once?
explanation: A @TestSetup method runs before the test methods and its records are available to each of them; any changes a test makes are rolled back before the next.
options: A static block in the class

stem: Which Salesforce CLI command pushes local source from force-app to an org?
explanation: sf project deploy start deploys local source to the target org; sf project retrieve start pulls changes back. sf org create scratch makes a new org.

stem: In Visualforce's model-view-controller design, which part is the controller?
explanation: In Visualforce the view is the page markup, the model is the data (sObjects and Apex classes that represent it) and the controller is a standard controller or Apex class holding the logic.
options: Apex class with the page logic

stem: Which Apex call returns a map of every sObject name to its token?
explanation: Schema.getGlobalDescribe() returns a Map of sObject names to Schema.SObjectType tokens. describeSObjects needs the names you want, and getDescribe describes one type.

stem:
What does this Apex print?
$$\begin{array}{l}\texttt{Integer a = 7;}\\\texttt{Integer b = 2;}\\\texttt{System.debug(a / b);}\end{array}$$
explanation: Dividing one Integer by another in Apex returns an Integer, dropping the remainder, so 7 / 2 is 3. Casting one operand to Decimal would give 3.5.

stem: Why use a SOQL for loop over a very large query result?
explanation: A SOQL for loop retrieves records in chunks of 200, which keeps heap use low. The rows still count toward the 50,000-row limit, and the loop runs in one transaction.
options: It skips the SOQL query count
It processes records in batches of 200
It runs each batch in a new transaction

stem: A utility class must run in the sharing mode of whichever class calls it. Which declaration fits?
explanation: inherited sharing takes the caller's sharing mode at run time; as an entry point, such as an @AuraEnabled method, it runs with sharing. with caller sharing is not an Apex keyword.

stem: In $\texttt{@wire(getContacts, \{ accountId: \$recordId \}) contacts;}$, what does the dollar sign do?
explanation: A dollar-sign prefix on a property name in the wire configuration makes it reactive: when recordId changes, the wire service calls the method again with the new value.
options: Marks recordId as an Apex parameter
Passes recordId as a string literal
Reruns the call when recordId changes
Caches the result for the whole session

stem: Test methods can't make real HTTP callouts. How does a test cover callout code?
explanation: Tests do not support real callouts by default, so a class implementing HttpCalloutMock returns a fake response registered with Test.setMock. SeeAllData only opens org data.

stem: Salesforce's Aura guide says to choose which model for a new component, unless it needs an unsupported feature?
explanation: The Lightning Aura Components Developer Guide says to always choose Lightning Web Components unless you need a feature it does not support. LWC uses web standards and runs faster.

stem: A Task's WhatId can point to an Account or an Opportunity. Which SOQL feature returns different fields per type?
explanation: TYPEOF in the SELECT clause picks fields by the type the polymorphic field points to, with WHEN and ELSE branches. GROUP BY aggregates and FOR VIEW updates recently viewed data.

stem: A trigger must send each new Lead to an external API. How should the callout be made?
explanation: Callouts from a trigger must be asynchronous so the save is not held waiting. A future method needs callout=true, since the default blocks callouts.

stem: Where in Setup does an admin see the status of a running Batch Apex job?
explanation: The Apex Jobs page lists asynchronous jobs with their status and batches processed; code can query the same data from AsyncApexJob. Deployment Status tracks deployments.

stem: Which lifecycle hook runs when a component is inserted into the DOM?
explanation: connectedCallback is invoked when the component is inserted into the DOM, a common place to load data. disconnectedCallback runs when it is removed.

stem: Which custom exception declaration compiles?
explanation: A custom exception class must extend Exception (or another custom exception) and its name must end with Exception. Exception is a class, so implements does not apply.

stem:
What happens when this query finds no matching Account?
$$\begin{array}{l}\texttt{Account a = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Name = :n];}\end{array}$$
explanation: Assigning a query to a single sObject requires exactly one row; zero rows throws QueryException (List has no rows for assignment to SObject). Querying into a List avoids it.
options: a is set to a new empty Account

stem: A page uses the Account standard controller and needs one extra action. What should the developer write?
explanation: A controller extension adds or overrides behavior while keeping the standard controller's actions and its enforcement of user permissions. A custom controller must reimplement everything.

stem: Why should a trigger test insert 200 or more records?
explanation: Salesforce advises testing bulk cases as well as single records; 200 records fill a trigger batch and expose queries or DML inside loops that would hit governor limits.
options: To make the test run in batches
To avoid a mixed DML error
To prove the trigger is bulkified
To reach 75% code coverage more quickly

stem: A field must show Days Open from CreatedDate and is never edited. Which is the best fit?
explanation: A formula field is calculated when the record is read, so it stays current with no code or stored value to maintain. A trigger or scheduled job would store a number that goes stale.
options: Number field updated by a flow

stem: How is access to a detail record decided in a master-detail relationship?
explanation: The master controls who can view a detail record's data, so detail records do not get their own sharing. A lookup child keeps its own owner and sharing.
options: It is set by each detail's sharing rules
It is public read/write by default
It follows the detail record's owner

stem: How does Agentforce decide when to call an Apex agent action?
explanation: Agent Builder takes the action's label and instructions from the @InvocableMethod label and description, and the reasoning engine uses them to pick the action, so they must be clear.
options: Comments above the class and method
The method's name and its return type in Apex
The order the actions were added in

stem: An after update trigger updates the same records again and fires itself. What is a common guard?
explanation: Static variables last for the whole transaction, so a static flag (or a static Set of processed Ids) stops the second pass. Instance variables reset with each new object.
options: A static Boolean set on first run
An instance variable in the trigger
A custom field set to true

stem: Which two tasks does the Developer Console support? (Choose two.)
explanation: The Developer Console writes, compiles, debugs and tests Apex, shows debug logs and checkpoints, and runs SOQL in its Query Editor. Scratch orgs come from the Salesforce CLI and a Dev Hub.
options: Running SOQL in the Query Editor
Creating scratch orgs from a definition

stem: What does acct?.Owner?.Name return when acct is null?
explanation: The safe navigation operator short-circuits on a null reference and returns null instead of throwing a NullPointerException.

stem: What type does Apex return for a SOQL query with SUM(Amount) and GROUP BY?
explanation: Aggregate queries with GROUP BY return AggregateResult rows, read with get using the alias. SELECT COUNT() with no field list returns an Integer.

stem: Which method removes fields the user cannot read from a list of queried records?
explanation: Security.stripInaccessible returns the records with fields the user cannot access removed, so code can work on what remains. escapeSingleQuotes sanitizes input for queries.

stem: Where can System.runAs be used?
explanation: runAs runs a block as a given user, enforcing that user's sharing and permissions, and it is available only in test methods. Each call counts toward the DML statement limit.

stem: Agentforce Vibes (formerly Agentforce for Developers) is asked the same prompt twice. What does Salesforce say to expect?
explanation: Salesforce says the generative AI output is often nondeterministic and can be inaccurate, so the developer reviews each result before use. It also writes LWC JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
options: Output cached for the whole org
Identical output for the same prompt
Output that can differ each time

stem: Which statement creates an Account in memory without saving it?
explanation: Calling the constructor with field names only builds the sObject in memory; nothing is saved until a DML statement runs. The insert forms write to the database.

stem: Which directive renders a block only when the property isReady is true?
explanation: lwc:if, with lwc:elseif and lwc:else, renders content conditionally and supersedes the older if:true and if:false. for:each repeats markup for each item in a list.

stem: How does a parent component call a method named play() on a child component?
explanation: A child method marked @api is public, and the parent calls it through this.template.querySelector on the child element. Events carry data from child to parent instead.

stem: Which practice best keeps a trigger within governor limits?
explanation: Bulkified code runs one query for the whole set of records, then works through the results. Queries inside a loop multiply with the batch size, and a LimitException cannot be caught.
options: Query each record inside the loop
Move each record to its own future call

stem: A Contact must be able to exist without a Region__c, and deleting a region must not delete contacts. Which field fits?
explanation: A lookup relationship is optional and loosely coupled, so the child can exist alone and survives a deleted parent. A master-detail detail must have a master and is deleted with it.

stem: By default, can an Apex test method saved with API version 24.0 or later see existing records in the org?
explanation: From API version 24.0 tests cannot see org data by default, so each test creates its own. @IsTest(SeeAllData=true) opens access to all org data.

stem: Which part of a record-triggered flow can send an email alert after the record is saved?
explanation: The Actions and Related Records option runs after save and can call actions such as email alerts or update other records. Fast Field Updates can only change the triggering record.

stem: How many DML statements can one Apex transaction issue?
explanation: The limit is 150 DML statements, synchronous or asynchronous. 10,000 is the number of records DML can process, a separate limit.

stem: What does declaring a class without sharing do?
explanation: without sharing stops the class enforcing the current user's sharing rules, so it can reach records the user cannot see. It is about record access, not field permissions.
options: Runs the code as the org's admin user

stem: Which context variable gives a map of Ids to the new record versions in an after insert trigger?
explanation: Trigger.newMap maps Ids to new versions; it exists in before update and in after insert, update and undelete. Trigger.new is a list, and oldMap is for update and delete.

stem: A deployment to production includes Apex classes and sets no test level. Which tests run?
explanation: With no test level, a production deployment containing Apex runs all tests except those from managed packages; a deployment with no Apex runs none by default.
options: No tests, as none were named
Only tests named in the package
Only tests in the new classes

stem: An LWC must update a record through Apex when a button is clicked. How is the method called?
explanation: Methods that change data cannot be cacheable, and wired methods must be cacheable, so the component imports the method and calls it imperatively, handling the promise with then and catch.

stem: Invoice__c has a lookup to Account. How can Account show its invoice total without changing the relationship?
explanation: Roll-up summary fields need master-detail, so with a lookup the total must be calculated by automation such as a trigger or flow with an aggregate. A cross-object formula reads parent fields from the child.
options: A roll-up summary field on Account
Apex or a flow that sums the invoices

stem: An upsert on an external ID field finds two records with the same value. What happens?
explanation: Upsert inserts when the key is not matched and updates when it is matched once. If the key matches more than once, an error is generated and nothing is inserted or updated for that record.
options: The most recently edited one is updated
The record errors and is not saved

stem: When are records made in a @TestSetup method rolled back?
explanation: Test setup records are rolled back when the whole class finishes, while changes a test method makes to them are rolled back after that method, so each test starts from the same data.
options: At the end of the test class
At the end of the day

stem: Which signature is valid for an @InvocableMethod?
explanation: An invocable method must be static and public or global, and its one input and its output must be lists so the flow can pass records in bulk. A single Id is not allowed.

stem: Which query uses an Apex variable safely in the WHERE clause?
explanation: A colon before the variable makes it a bind variable, which Apex passes as a value, never as query text. The other forms are not valid SOQL.
options: $\texttt{[SELECT Id FROM Lead WHERE Email = addr]}$

stem: Which constructor does a controller extension for a standard controller need?
explanation: An extension of a standard controller takes ApexPages.StandardController as its constructor argument, which gives access to the record. StandardSetController is the argument for a list controller extension.

stem: From which module does an LWC import the getCases method of the Apex class CaseCtrl?
explanation: Apex methods are imported from the @salesforce/apex namespace as ClassName.methodName. @salesforce/schema imports object and field references.

stem: A data load inserts 1,000 records. How does an insert trigger on that object run?
explanation: DML on more than 200 records is split into batches of 200, and the trigger fires once per batch; Trigger.size gives the current batch's count.

stem: Why do coverage numbers in a Full sandbox match production more closely than in a Developer sandbox?
explanation: A Full sandbox copies production's data as well as metadata, so tests that touch data behave as in production. The Apex guide recommends it for staging production deployments.

stem: Which of these can Apex not do, according to the Apex Developer Guide?
explanation: The guide lists what Apex cannot do: render UI other than error messages, change standard functionality, create temporary files and spawn threads. Queueable jobs, JSON parsing and static method calls are all supported.

stem: An Opportunity is related to an Account by setting Account to new Account(ERP_Id__c = id) before insert. What does this need?
explanation: A parent reference built with only an external ID field resolves the foreign key during the DML, so no query for the parent Id is needed. The field must be an external ID on the parent.
options: A query for the Account's Id first
The Account inserted in the same list

stem: A test needs to read a private variable in the class under test. Which annotation allows it?
explanation: @TestVisible lets test methods reach private or protected members of the class under test without making them public.

stem: A component wires a cacheable Apex method, then updates a record imperatively. How does it get fresh data?
explanation: A cacheable result is refreshed by calling refreshApex with the value the wire provisioned. Calling the cacheable method imperatively does not refresh the wire's cache.
options: Setting the wired field to null

stem:
The String name holds a word. What does this set b to?
$$\begin{array}{l}\texttt{String up = name.toUpperCase();}\\\texttt{String low = name.toLowerCase();}\\\texttt{Boolean b = (up == low);}\end{array}$$
explanation: In Apex, == compares strings without regard to case, so the upper and lower case versions are equal. Use the equals method for a case-sensitive comparison.

stem: How many records can a single SOSL query return?
explanation: One SOSL query returns at most 2,000 records, and a transaction can run 20 SOSL queries. SOQL has the 50,000-row limit.

stem: What does String.escapeSingleQuotes do to user input?
explanation: escapeSingleQuotes adds a backslash before each single quote so the input stays inside the string literal instead of ending it early and adding query text.
options: Removes every single quote from the string
Wraps the string in double quotes
Escapes each single quote with a backslash

stem: What happens when a developer saves an Apex class to the platform?
explanation: The application server compiles Apex into instructions for the runtime interpreter and saves them as metadata. At run time those stored instructions are retrieved and interpreted.
options: It is copied to every org on the instance
It is compiled and stored as metadata
It is stored as source and compiled on each run
It is uploaded to a separate app server

stem: Which subquery returns each Account's Contacts?
explanation: A parent-to-child subquery uses the child relationship name, which for standard objects is usually the plural, Contacts. Custom child relationships end in __r.

stem: A workflow field update changes a record that was just saved. What runs again?
explanation: Workflow field updates cause before update and after update triggers to fire one more time, and only once. Custom validation rules and flows are not run again.
options: Before and after update triggers, once
Nothing, since the record is already committed

stem: Two records must be created so that both save or neither does. Why use Apex rather than LDS createRecord?
explanation: LDS functions work on single records and each runs in its own transaction, so there is no shared rollback. Apex DML in one method commits or rolls back together.
options: Each LDS call is its own transaction
LDS skips validation rules and triggers

stem: Which assertion throws an error when the expected and actual values differ?
explanation: Assert.areEqual throws an assertion error that fails the test when the values differ. System.debug only logs, and isInstanceOfType checks a value's type.

stem: A debug log grows past 20 MB. What happens?
explanation: Each debug log must be 20 MB or smaller; larger logs are reduced by removing older lines, such as earlier System.debug output, from anywhere in the log.
options: Older lines are removed to shrink it
The log is split into two smaller files

stem: Which requirement is better met declaratively than with an Apex trigger?
explanation: A before-save record-triggered flow or default value sets a field on create with no code to test or maintain. Callouts, batch processing and web services need Apex.
options: Set a default field value on create
Call an external REST service on save
Expose a method to an external app

stem: Which expression tells Apex whether the running user can read Account.Industry?
explanation: The DescribeFieldResult method isAccessible checks field-level read access for the running user. isQueryable is object-level, and isUpdateable checks edit access.

stem: A method receives a String and assigns it a new value. What does the caller's variable hold afterward?
explanation: Primitive arguments such as String are passed by value, so reassigning the parameter inside the method does not change the caller's variable.

stem: After Database.update(recs, false), how does code find the reason a record failed?
explanation: With allOrNone false no exception is thrown for failed records; each Database.SaveResult reports isSuccess and getErrors. Only all-or-nothing DML throws DmlException.

stem: In API version 67.0 and later, whose object and field permissions does Apex enforce by default?
explanation: From API version 67.0, Apex runs in user context by default, enforcing the current user's object permissions and field-level security; to ignore them code must ask for system mode. In API version 66.0 and earlier, Apex ran in system mode by default, ignoring the user's object permissions and field-level security unless code checked them.
options: None, it runs in system mode

stem: Which event type name follows the LWC naming rules?
explanation: Event types should have no uppercase letters and no spaces, using underscores if words must be split. The parent's handler adds the on prefix, as in ontileselect.

stem: Which method loads test records from a CSV file stored as a static resource?
explanation: Test.loadData reads a static resource CSV and inserts the records for the test. setFixedSearchResults defines what a SOSL query returns in a test.

stem: Why do Lightning Web Components load faster than Aura components?
explanation: LWC uses core Web Components standards that browsers run natively and adds only what is needed, so it is lighter than the Aura framework. Both render in the browser, not on the server.

stem: On which object can a hierarchical relationship field be created?
explanation: A hierarchical relationship is a special lookup available only on the User object, such as a Manager field. Other objects relate records to themselves with an ordinary lookup.

stem: Which asynchronous tool returns a job Id and can take an sObject list as a member variable?
explanation: Queueable Apex returns a job Id from System.enqueueJob, supports non-primitive types and can chain jobs. Future methods take only primitive parameters and return no Id.

stem: Which file defines a Salesforce DX project's package directories and API version?
explanation: sfdx-project.json configures the DX project, including its package directories. project-scratch-def.json describes the shape of a scratch org.

stem: When @wire decorates a property, where do the results arrive?
explanation: The wire service sets the property to an object with data and error properties. Imperative Apex calls return promises instead.
options: In a promise from the property
In its data and error properties

stem: Which Apex statement picks a branch by matching one value against several literals?
explanation: Apex's switch statement starts with switch on and lists when branches, with when else as the default. select case, if case and case of are not Apex.

stem: Which SOQL keywords lock the returned records so another process cannot change them mid-update?
explanation: FOR UPDATE locks the queried records until the transaction ends. FOR VIEW updates the recently viewed list, and ALL ROWS includes deleted records.

stem: A Visualforce page's view state is too large. Which change reduces it?
explanation: Transient instance variables are not saved in the view state, which has a 170 KB limit. More forms add view state, and actionRegion limits what is processed, not what is stored.
options: Move fields to a static resource

stem: How do classes marked @IsTest count toward the org's limit on Apex code size?
explanation: Classes defined with the @IsTest annotation do not count against the org's limit for the total size of Apex code.
options: They count only if they fail

stem: Which two statements about formula fields are true? (Choose two.)
explanation: A formula field is read-only and calculated each time the record is read, and cross-object formulas can reference parent fields. Summing children takes a roll-up summary field.
options: Value is calculated when the record is read
Can sum the values of child records
Value is stored and indexed on save
Can be edited by users with access
Can reference fields on a parent record

stem: Which two features are only available when the child uses a master-detail relationship? (Choose two.)
explanation: Roll-up summaries and inherited sharing need master-detail. Cross-object formulas, related lists and lookup filters work with lookup relationships too.
options: Child records listed in a related list
Roll-up summary fields on the parent

stem: Two components on one Lightning page are not in the same DOM tree. Which feature lets them communicate?
explanation: Lightning Message Service publishes messages on a message channel across the DOM, between LWC, Aura and Visualforce. Events and @api need a parent-child relationship.

stem: How does a before trigger stop one record from saving and show the user a message?
explanation: addError on the record (or one of its fields) blocks that record's save and shows the message. An uncaught exception fails the whole operation, not just the one record.

stem: A team moves Apex from a sandbox to its own production org through Setup, with no CLI. Which tool fits?
explanation: Change sets deploy metadata between related orgs, such as a sandbox and its production org, over a deployment connection. Data Loader moves records, not code.

stem: When does the code in a finally block run?
explanation: A finally block always runs after the try and any catch, so it suits cleanup. A LimitException ends the transaction and cannot be caught at all.
options: Whether or not an exception occurs
Only when the catch block rethrows

stem: How many records of the same sObject type can one merge operation combine?
explanation: merge combines up to three records of the same type, keeping the master record and deleting the others while reparenting their related records.

stem: Which code is not protected by Visualforce's built-in XSS filtering?
explanation: Standard apex components escape output by default, but custom JavaScript and code inside apex:includeScript have no built-in XSS protection; the developer must escape it.

stem: A test runs 98 queries, calls Test.startTest(), then runs code. How many queries can that code make?
explanation: startTest adds a fresh context with its own limit of 100 synchronous queries. After stopTest the test is back in the first context with only 2 left.

stem: Where does a developer use the Agentforce Vibes extension (formerly Agentforce for Developers)?
explanation: The extension ships with the Salesforce Extension Pack for Visual Studio Code and works with Salesforce DX projects, giving inline completions and an agentic chat.
options: In VS Code with a Salesforce DX project
In the Setup menu's Flow Builder
In the Visualforce development mode footer

stem: Why use the generic sObject type in a method?
explanation: The sObject type can hold any record, which suits code that handles several objects; you cast to Account or Contact to use their fields. It does not change DML or security.
options: It makes queries run in system mode
It can hold a record of any object

stem: Which two statements about LWC decorators are true? (Choose two.)
explanation: A property or function can have only one decorator, and every public @api property is reactive. Since Spring '20 fields are reactive without @track, which observes inner changes.
options: @api fields can be set only by Apex
A field can have only one decorator

stem: Which two per-transaction limits are the same for synchronous and asynchronous Apex? (Choose two.)
explanation: DML statements (150) and SOQL rows (50,000) do not change. SOQL queries rise to 200 and CPU time to 60,000 ms asynchronously, while System.enqueueJob drops from 50 jobs to 1.

stem: How many levels of parent-to-child subqueries can a SOQL query have in API version 58.0 and later?
explanation: From API version 58.0, SOQL can nest up to five levels of parent-to-child relationships; earlier versions allowed one. A query with more than five levels errors.

stem: What does $\texttt{label ?? fallback}$ return when label is null?
explanation: The null coalescing operator ?? returns its right-hand operand when the left one is null, replacing an explicit null check.

stem: How many records can all SOQL queries in one transaction retrieve in total?
explanation: SOQL queries can retrieve 50,000 records per transaction. 10,000 is the DML row limit, and 2,000 is the most one SOSL query returns.

stem: Which trigger context lets code read the records being deleted, by Id?
explanation: Delete triggers have Trigger.old and Trigger.oldMap. Trigger.new and newMap are not available because the records have no new version.

stem: What must each item in a for:each loop have?
explanation: Salesforce's guide says every item rendered with for:each or iterator needs a key with a unique Id, so the framework can track which items change.
options: A data-id attribute set to its index

stem: In API version 67.0 and later, how does a class with no sharing keyword run?
explanation: From API version 67.0, Apex without an explicit sharing declaration runs with sharing, unless it extends a parent class, whose mode it adopts. In API version 66.0 and earlier, such a class usually ran without sharing unless it was an Aura or LWC controller or was called from a with sharing class. Salesforce recommends always declaring it.

stem: What does Salesforce say to focus on instead of the coverage percentage?
explanation: The Apex guide says not to focus on the percentage but on testing every use case: positive and negative, and bulk as well as single records.
options: Raising coverage to 100% on every class
Testing positive, negative and bulk cases
Testing against copies of production data

stem: What is the longest a scratch org can last?
explanation: A scratch org can be set to last from 1 to 30 days when created; the default is 7. An expired scratch org cannot be restored.

stem: Who can get an email when Apex uses more than 50% of a governor limit?
explanation: You can specify users in the org to receive an email when their Apex surpasses 50% of an allocated per-request limit. These warnings do not count against the daily single email limit.

stem: How many levels up can a child-to-parent relationship path go in SOQL, as in Contact.Account.Owner.Name?
explanation: The SOQL reference allows no more than five levels in a child-to-parent relationship, and no more than 55 child-to-parent relationships in one query.

stem: Which collection keeps only unique values with no guaranteed order?
explanation: A Set holds unique elements; adding a value already present has no effect. Lists and arrays keep order and allow duplicates, and a Map stores key-value pairs.

stem: A query on Account includes one Contacts subquery. How does it count against the query limits?
explanation: Each parent-child relationship subquery counts as an extra query, against a separate limit three times the top-level one. Rows from the subquery count toward the row limit.
options: Subquery counts as an extra query
Each Contact row counts as a query

stem: Which context variable returns a value such as BEFORE_UPDATE for use in a switch?
explanation: Trigger.operationType returns a System.TriggerOperation enum value like BEFORE_UPDATE or AFTER_INSERT. isExecuting only says the code is running in a trigger.

stem: A child has the public property itemName. Which attribute sets it in the parent's markup?
explanation: Markup attributes use kebab case, so item-name maps to the JavaScript property itemName.

stem: Which DML call enforces the running user's object, field and sharing permissions whatever the class's API version?
explanation: Passing AccessLevel.USER_MODE to a Database method enforces the running user's permissions for that operation. SYSTEM_MODE and insert as system ignore them, and false only sets partial success. A plain insert follows the default, which changed in API version 67.0.

stem: In a test, what happens to a batch job started between startTest and stopTest?
explanation: All asynchronous work started after startTest runs synchronously when stopTest executes, so the batch's results can be asserted right after.
options: It is skipped in test context
It must be mocked with a stub
It runs after the whole test method ends

stem: What must the Salesforce CLI connect to before it can create scratch orgs?
explanation: Scratch orgs are created from a Dev Hub, an org with the Dev Hub feature enabled, that the CLI is authorized to. Packages are built from the Dev Hub too.

stem: Why must trigger code be written to handle many records in one call?
explanation: DML on many records fires a trigger once per chunk of 200, and governor limits count for the whole transaction, so code that queries or saves per record runs out of limits.
options: Bulk API loads skip the trigger
Each record runs in its own transaction
Limits apply per record, not per call

stem: Which method upserts a list of Assets using Line_Item_Id__c as the match key?
explanation: Database.upsert takes the list and a field token naming the external ID field (the statement form is upsert assets Asset.Line_Item_Id__c;). merge combines duplicates of one object.

stem: A Map<Id, Account> is asked for a key it does not contain. What does get return?
explanation: Map.get returns null for a missing key, so check for null or use containsKey before using the result. Index errors are thrown by lists, not maps.
options: The first value in the map

stem: How many records can DML statements process in one transaction?
explanation: DML can process 10,000 records per transaction. 150 is the number of DML statements, and 50,000 is the SOQL row limit.

stem: An object has two before insert triggers. In what order do they fire?
explanation: When more than one trigger exists for the same object and event, the firing order is not guaranteed. That is a reason to keep one trigger per object that calls a handler.

stem: Which Apex method signature can an LWC call?
explanation: Methods called from Lightning components must be static, public or global, and annotated @AuraEnabled. Instance and private methods are not exposed, and a method without the annotation is not reachable.

stem: Which page attribute lets a standard controller work with a list of records?
explanation: Adding recordSetVar to an apex:page with a standardController makes it a standard list controller over a set of records. extensions names controller extension classes.

stem: Why do test methods create their own records rather than rely on org data?
explanation: Tests that build their own data pass in every org they are deployed to and are not broken by changes to real records. Test data is never committed.
options: Org data is read-only in tests
Tests must work in any org

stem: Which CLI command runs Apex tests in an org?
explanation: sf apex run test runs Apex tests and reports results, for example with --result-format human. sf apex get log fetches a debug log.

stem: A master object must show the latest Close Date among its detail records. Which roll-up type fits?
explanation: MAX returns the highest value of a number, currency, percent, date or date/time field, so the latest date. MIN would give the earliest.

stem: Salesforce describes AccountContactRelation, linking contacts to many accounts, as which kind of object?
explanation: A junction object has two master-detail relationships and models a many-to-many relationship; AccountContactRelation lets one contact relate to several accounts.

stem: What is true of Apex methods and classes by default?
explanation: Methods and classes are final by default; the virtual modifier allows extension and overriding, and an override must use the override keyword.

stem: How does Database.setSavepoint() count against governor limits?
explanation: Setting a savepoint and rolling back each count toward the DML statement limit but not the DML row limit. Static variables are not reverted by a rollback.
options: It counts against no governor limit

stem: Deleting an Account cascades to its child records. Which records fire delete triggers?
explanation: Cascading delete operations do not invoke triggers on the cascaded records; only the record that started the delete is evaluated.

stem: In API version 55.0 and later, what is not allowed on @AuraEnabled methods?
explanation: From API version 55.0 an @AuraEnabled method cannot be overloaded; give each method a different name. Static, public and list-returning methods are normal.

stem: A page shows {!greeting}. Which controller member supplies the value?
explanation: A merge field such as {!greeting} calls the getter getGreeting (or reads a public property). Setters write values from the page, and a private field without a getter is not visible.

stem: How many times can one test method call Test.startTest()?
explanation: Each test method may call startTest only once and stopTest only once.

stem: How long are system debug logs kept?
explanation: System debug logs are kept for 24 hours; monitoring debug logs are kept for seven days.

stem: A Case must not save if another open Case on the same Account has the same Type. What is needed?
explanation: The check needs to read other Case records, which a validation rule formula on the saved record cannot count, and Account to Case is a lookup, so no roll-up summary is possible. A before trigger queries them in bulk and calls addError.
options: A roll-up of open Cases on Account
A formula field counting open Cases
A validation rule on the Case

stem: Apex changes Amount on a queried record, then reads a formula field built on Amount. What value does it get?
explanation: Formula fields return their value as of the query; changes to the fields they use show only after the record is saved and queried again, or after Formula.recalculateFormulas.
options: The value from when it was queried
Null until the record is saved
An error for reading a stale field
The new value, recalculated at once

stem: Which access modifier lets code outside the namespace, such as a managed package's subscribers, call a method?
explanation: global makes a method usable outside the application or namespace. public is visible only inside the namespace, and a global method needs a global class.

stem: Which keywords let a SOQL query return records in the Recycle Bin?
explanation: ALL ROWS returns deleted and archived records, for example to undelete them. It cannot be combined with FOR UPDATE.

stem: Which three methods does a class implementing Database.Batchable define?
explanation: start gathers the records (a QueryLocator or Iterable), execute processes each batch with fresh governor limits, and finish runs once at the end.

stem: What can't a method annotated @AuraEnabled(cacheable=true) do?
explanation: Cacheable methods may only read data, so DML is not allowed. They can still be called imperatively as well as wired.

stem: What does a Visualforce action method return to send the user to another page?
explanation: An action method returns a PageReference to navigate, or null to stay on the same page. ApexPages.Message is for adding messages to the page.

stem: A static variable is initialized to 5. One test method changes it to 9. What does the next test method see?
explanation: Each test method, and the setup method, runs as its own transaction, and the static context is reinitialized before each, so static initializers run again and the next method sees 5.

stem: Which test level runs only the classes you name when deploying?
explanation: RunSpecifiedTests with --tests runs only the listed test classes, and they must still meet coverage for the deployed code. RunLocalTests runs every test outside managed packages.

stem: Which configuration records can be deployed between orgs with the metadata?
explanation: Records of custom metadata types are metadata, so they move with change sets and Metadata API deployments. Custom setting and custom object records are data and must be loaded separately.

stem: Which describe call returns the values of a picklist field?
explanation: DescribeFieldResult.getPicklistValues returns the field's PicklistEntry list. getReferenceTo lists the objects a lookup can point to.

stem: A DML insert fails a validation rule. Which exception type can the code catch?
explanation: A failed DML operation throws System.DmlException, whose getDmlMessage gives the rule's error. QueryException comes from SOQL, and LimitException cannot be caught.

stem: Why does inserting a User with a role and an Account in one transaction fail?
explanation: DML on setup objects such as User (with a role) and on non-setup objects such as Account in one transaction causes a mixed DML error. Move one part to a future method.
options: Users can't be inserted in Apex
Setup and non-setup DML can't mix
User needs a SOSL search first

stem: What is the default batch size for Database.executeBatch?
explanation: The default scope is 200 records. With a QueryLocator the scope can be set up to 2,000.

stem: Why do two components showing the same record stay in sync after one edits it through LDS?
explanation: Lightning Data Service keeps a client-side cache shared across components, so a change made through LDS shows in every component using that record. Apex results are cached separately.
options: Each polls the server every second
They share the LDS client cache

stem: Whose permissions does a standard controller enforce on a Visualforce page?
explanation: Standard controllers run in user mode, enforcing the current user's permissions, field-level security and sharing; that is why extending one keeps a page within the user's access.

stem: Which annotation marks a class that holds only test code?
explanation: @IsTest marks test classes and test methods. @TestSetup marks the method that builds shared data, and @TestVisible exposes private members to tests.

stem: Which Developer Console feature runs a block of Apex once without saving a class?
explanation: Execute Anonymous compiles and runs a code block once, and its output appears in a debug log. The Query Editor only runs SOQL.

stem: How do SOQL queries on custom metadata types count against the per-transaction query limit?
explanation: The Apex guide says the SOQL query limit does not apply to custom metadata types, so a transaction can run unlimited queries on custom metadata records.

stem: A Contact has the fields AccountId and Account. What does the Account field hold?
explanation: Each relationship has two fields: an Id field (AccountId) and a field of the parent's type (Account) that points to the related sObject, so contact.Account.Name works after a query.
options: A list of the Account's contacts

stem: Which loop runs once for every element of the list accts?
explanation: Apex's list or set iteration loop is for (Type variable : collection). in, foreach and as belong to other languages.

stem: Which method runs a SOQL query built as a String at run time?
explanation: Database.query runs dynamic SOQL and counts toward the SOQL limit. Search.query runs dynamic SOSL, and the other two methods do not exist.

stem: Why can't a future method take a List<Account> parameter?
explanation: Future method parameters must be primitives or collections of them. An sObject could change between the call and the run, so pass Ids and query fresh data.
options: Records may change before it runs

stem: When would you choose lightning-record-edit-form over lightning-record-form?
explanation: The view and edit forms let you lay out fields yourself, prepopulate values and change rendering. lightning-record-form is the quick option driven by a layout or field list.
options: To lay out fields or prefill values
To show a list of many records
To create a record with no fields

stem: Which describe check confirms the user may create Contact records before an insert?
explanation: isCreateable checks the object-level create permission. isAccessible is read, isUpdateable is edit and isDeletable is delete.

stem: A SOSL query in a test returns no records. Which method makes it return chosen record Ids?
explanation: SOSL in a test returns nothing unless Test.setFixedSearchResults supplies the Ids it should return. loadData inserts records from a CSV.

stem: Which tool lets a developer step through a recorded debug log in VS Code with breakpoints?
explanation: Apex Replay Debugger reads a debug log and replays it with breakpoints and variable inspection in VS Code, with no extra license.

stem: When Apex load grows, who handles scaling the platform it runs on?
explanation: The Apex guide says that in a multitenant cloud you do not have to scale your code because the platform does it for you; governor limits keep any one transaction from monopolizing it.
options: Each org's admin, by adding servers
Salesforce, as part of the platform
Each org, by buying more capacity

stem: When will an upsert on a custom external ID match the value ABC123 to an existing abc123?
explanation: Custom field matching is case-insensitive only when the field is Unique with the option to treat ABC and abc as duplicate values; otherwise, including an External ID field that is not Unique or is case-sensitive, ABC123 and abc123 are different keys.
options: Field set as Unique and case-sensitive
Field set as Unique and case-insensitive
Field set as Required and External ID
Field set as External ID only

stem: How long does a static variable in an Apex class keep its value?
explanation: Static variables are initialized once per transaction and keep their value only for that transaction, which is why they suit recursion flags in triggers.

stem: What does a SOSL query in Apex return?
explanation: SOSL returns a list of lists, one inner list per object in the RETURNING clause, in that order.

stem: Which interface does a class implement to run Apex at a set time?
explanation: A Schedulable class has an execute(SchedulableContext) method and is scheduled with System.schedule or from Setup. Synchronous limits apply to scheduled jobs.

stem: Which hook is the place to clean up, such as removing a listener, when a component leaves the page?
explanation: disconnectedCallback is invoked when the component is removed from the DOM, so cleanup belongs there. connectedCallback runs on insertion.

stem: Code uses without sharing to show records the user cannot normally see. What does Salesforce advise?
explanation: Salesforce recommends without sharing only for classes that require system-level access, since they can reach records beyond the user's access. Triggers cannot carry a sharing keyword.
options: Put it on the trigger itself
Use it on every Visualforce controller
Only for classes that need system access

stem: Inside a runAs block, whose sharing mode applies to a method defined in another class?
explanation: The guide says a user-defined method called in a runAs block uses the sharing mode of the class where it is defined, not the test class's.

stem: What happens when an org writes more than 1,000 MB of debug logs in 15 minutes?
explanation: Generating over 1,000 MB of logs in a 15-minute window disables trace flags, and the users who last changed them are told they can re-enable them after 15 minutes.
options: The org's API calls are blocked

stem: What must be enabled before Agentforce Vibes works in VS Code?
explanation: Salesforce says to enable Salesforce telemetry in VS Code and the Salesforce CLI before using Agentforce Vibes, then reload the window.

stem: Apex reads a field that was not in the SOQL query for that record. What happens?
explanation: Reading a field that the query did not retrieve throws System.SObjectException at run time. Apex does not fetch it automatically.

stem: Which keyword makes a class provide the methods of an interface?
explanation: A class implements an interface and must define all its methods. extends is for inheriting from a virtual or abstract class.

stem: Which DML operation inserts new records and updates existing ones in one call?
explanation: upsert matches records on Id or an external ID: unmatched records are inserted and matched ones updated. merge combines duplicates.

stem: When do queueable jobs enqueued during a save actually run?
explanation: Enqueued asynchronous Apex, including queueable jobs and future methods, is post-commit logic: it starts only after all DML is committed.

stem: An ISV packages an Apex agent action. What access must the @InvocableMethod class have?
explanation: Agents cannot yet be packaged with a namespace, so they reach only global Apex in a managed package: the class, the method, the wrapper classes and their invocable variables.

stem: Why is a bind variable safer than adding user input to a dynamic SOQL string?
explanation: A bind variable is passed to the query engine as data, so input such as a quote and an OR clause cannot change the query's logic.
options: Input is treated as a value, not code

stem: How does a test set the page a Visualforce controller reads its parameters from?
explanation: Test.setCurrentPage sets the current PageReference, so ApexPages.currentPage().getParameters() in the controller reads the values the test puts on it.

stem: A developer needs to fix a bug in production Apex. Where must the change be made?
explanation: Apex cannot be developed directly in a production org; it is written in a sandbox, scratch org or Developer Edition org and deployed with tests.
